papers.title: Study on the Selective Laser Melting of AlSi10Mg

llm.relevance_to_user: 与生物医学AM方向无关，专注于AlSi10Mg合金的SLM工艺参数研究
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration; no biomedical context or implant-related mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究AlSi10Mg合金SLM工艺参数对成型质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM实验制备试样，分析激光功率、扫描速度等参数
summary_zh.result: 获得了优化的工艺参数窗口，改善了致密度和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和力学测试验证工艺效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of Selective Laser Melting process parameters on the quality of AlSi10Mg alloy parts.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by SLM under varying laser power and scanning speed, and their density and mechanical properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Optimized process parameters were identified, yielding high density and improved mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via density measurements and mechanical testing (e.g., tensile or hardness tests).

papers.title: Diode-based additive manufacturing of metals using an optically-addressable light valve
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) of metal powder bed layers, whereby 3D metal objects can be printed from a digital file with unprecedented design flexibility, is spurring manufacturing innovations in medical, automotive, aerospace and textile industries. Because SLM is based on raster-scanning a laser beam over each layer, the process is relatively slow compared to most traditional manufacturing methods (hours to days), thus limiting wider spread use. Here we demonstrate the use of a large area, photolithographic method for 3D metal printing, using an optically-addressable light valve (OALV) as the photomask, to print entire layers of metal powder at once. An optical sheet of multiplexed ~5 kW, 20 ms laser diode and ~1 MW, 7 ns Q-switched laser pulses are used to selectively melt each layer. The patterning of near infrared light is accomplished by imaging 470 nm light onto the transmissive OALV, which consists of polarization-selective nematic liquid crystal sandwiched between a photoconductor and transparent conductor for switching.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的金属增材制造方法，但未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not include LPBF fabrication of biomedical implants, lacks mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and does not report surface morphology or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高选择性激光熔化金属3D打印的速度。
summary_zh.method: 使用光学寻址光阀作为光掩模，实现整层金属粉末同时熔化。
summary_zh.result: 展示了使用二极管激光器和Q开关激光脉冲进行整层打印的可行性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验展示打印过程，未进行力学性能验证。

summary_en.motivation: To increase the speed of selective laser melting by printing entire layers at once.
summary_en.method: An optically-addressable light valve is used as a photomask to pattern near-infrared light for melting metal powder layers.
summary_en.result: The technique demonstrates the feasibility of layer-wise metal printing using a combination of diode and Q-switched lasers.
summary_en.validation: The validation is purely demonstrational; no mechanical testing or material property evaluation is performed.
